package cardrpg

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"math"
)

type Card struct {
	ID                         int64
	Template                   int
	Level, Stars, Shards, Gear int64
}
type DrawReceipt struct {
	Seq                 uint64
	Count               int
	Version, ConfigHash string
	Templates           []int
	GemsAfter           int64
}
type Manage struct {
	Seq            uint64
	Kind           string
	CardID, Target int64
	Team           [3]int64
}
type Managed struct {
	Request    Manage
	ConfigHash string
}
type Admission struct {
	Seq        uint64
	RunID      int64
	Stage      int
	ConfigHash string
	Claimed    bool
}
type Profile struct {
	Schema                             int
	DrawKey                            string // 服务器私有随机密钥；绝不进入客户端投影 / 日志。
	Gems, Gold, Dust, Energy, EnergyAt int64
	Cards                              []Card
	Team                               [3]int64
	Pity                               int
	Draws                              []DrawReceipt
	Operations                         []Managed
	Runs                               []Admission
	ActiveRun                          int64
	Clears                             [3]int
	Wins                               int64
	QuestClaimed                       bool
}

func NewProfile(key string, now int64) (Profile, error) {
	raw, err := hex.DecodeString(key)
	if err != nil || len(raw) != 32 || !ValidTime(now) {
		return Profile{}, ErrRule
	}
	p := Profile{Schema: 1, DrawKey: key, Gems: 100, Gold: 100, Dust: 20, Energy: 10, EnergyAt: now, Team: [3]int64{1, 2, 3}}
	for i := range 3 {
		p.Cards = append(p.Cards, Card{ID: int64(i + 1), Template: i + 1, Level: 1, Stars: 1})
	}
	return p, nil
}
func (p Profile) Encode() string { return encode(p) }
func DecodeProfile(raw string) (Profile, error) {
	var p Profile
	if err := StrictJSON(raw, &p); err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	key, err := hex.DecodeString(p.DrawKey)
	if err != nil || len(key) != 32 || p.Schema != 1 || p.EnergyAt <= 0 || p.Gems < 0 || p.Gems > ValueLimit || p.Gold < 0 || p.Gold > ValueLimit || p.Dust < 0 || p.Dust > ValueLimit || p.Energy < 0 || p.Energy > 10 || p.Pity < 0 || p.Pity > 10 || len(p.Cards) < 3 || len(p.Cards) > 6 || len(p.Draws) > LedgerLimit || len(p.Operations) > LedgerLimit || len(p.Runs) > LedgerLimit {
		return p, ErrRule
	}
	for i, c := range p.Cards {
		if c.ID != int64(c.Template) || c.Template < 1 || c.Template > 6 || c.Level < 1 || c.Level > 10 || c.Stars < 1 || c.Stars > 3 || c.Shards < 0 || c.Shards > 640 || c.Gear < 0 || c.Gear > 3 {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if p.Cards[j].ID == c.ID {
				return p, ErrRule
			}
		}
	}
	if !p.validTeam(p.Team) || p.Wins < 0 || p.Wins > ValueLimit || p.QuestClaimed && p.Wins == 0 {
		return p, ErrRule
	}
	validHash := func(value string) bool { raw, err := hex.DecodeString(value); return err == nil && len(raw) == 32 }
	for i, receipt := range p.Draws {
		if receipt.Seq != uint64(i+1) || receipt.Count != 1 && receipt.Count != 10 || len(receipt.Templates) != receipt.Count || !validHash(receipt.ConfigHash) || receipt.Version == "" || receipt.GemsAfter < 0 || receipt.GemsAfter > ValueLimit {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
		for _, id := range receipt.Templates {
			if id < 1 || id > 6 {
				return p, ErrRule
			}
		}
	}
	for i, op := range p.Operations {
		if op.Request.Seq != uint64(i+1) || !validHash(op.ConfigHash) {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
	}
	active := 0
	for i, run := range p.Runs {
		if run.Seq != uint64(i+1) || run.RunID <= 0 || run.Stage < 1 || run.Stage > 3 || !validHash(run.ConfigHash) {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if p.Runs[j].RunID == run.RunID {
				return p, ErrRule
			}
		}
		if !run.Claimed {
			active++
			if run.RunID != p.ActiveRun {
				return p, ErrRule
			}
		}
	}
	if active > 1 || active == 0 && p.ActiveRun != 0 {
		return p, ErrRule
	}
	for _, stars := range p.Clears {
		if stars < 0 || stars > 3 {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
	}
	return p, nil
}
func (p *Profile) card(id int64) *Card {
	for i := range p.Cards {
		if p.Cards[i].ID == id {
			return &p.Cards[i]
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (p Profile) validTeam(team [3]int64) bool {
	for i, id := range team {
		if p.card(id) == nil {
			return false
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if team[j] == id {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// 体力按服务器时间补算，保留未满时的余数；满体力丢弃溢出的时间，时钟回退明确拒绝。
func (p *Profile) Regenerate(now int64) error {
	if now < p.EnergyAt {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if p.Energy == 10 {
		p.EnergyAt = now
		return nil
	}
	gain := (now - p.EnergyAt) / 3000
	if gain > 0 {
		p.Energy = min(int64(10), p.Energy+gain)
		if p.Energy == 10 {
			p.EnergyAt = now
		} else {
			p.EnergyAt += gain * 3000
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// HMAC 按领域、单调序号和槽位派生随机事实。测试密钥固定；正式服用 crypto/rand 初始化私有密钥。
func (p Profile) random(domain string, seq uint64, slot int) uint64 {
	key, _ := hex.DecodeString(p.DrawKey)
	h := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s:%d:%d", domain, seq, slot)
	return binary.BigEndian.Uint64(h.Sum(nil)[:8])
}
func (p Profile) BattleSeed(seq uint64) uint64 { return p.random("battle", seq, 0) | 1 }

// Draw 的接收者必须是从 DAO 解码出的事务局部副本；失败不能把半次十连写回。
func (p *Profile) Draw(seq uint64, count int, r Rules) (DrawReceipt, error) {
	if seq == 0 || count != 1 && count != 10 {
		return DrawReceipt{}, ErrRule
	}
	if seq <= uint64(len(p.Draws)) {
		old := p.Draws[seq-1]
		if old.Seq == seq && old.Count == count {
			return old, nil
		}
		return DrawReceipt{}, ErrRule
	}
	if seq != uint64(len(p.Draws))+1 || len(p.Draws) >= LedgerLimit || r.Validate() != nil || p.Gems < int64(count)*r.DrawCost {
		return DrawReceipt{}, ErrRule
	}
	receipt := DrawReceipt{Seq: seq, Count: count, Version: r.Version, ConfigHash: r.Hash()}
	for slot := range count {
		roll := p.random("draw", seq, slot)
		rare := roll%5 == 0 || p.Pity+1 >= r.Pity
		template := 1 + int((roll>>8)%3)
		if rare {
			template += 3
			p.Pity = 0
		} else {
			p.Pity++
		}
		receipt.Templates = append(receipt.Templates, template)
		if owned := p.card(int64(template)); owned != nil {
			owned.Shards++
			p.Dust++
		} else {
			p.Cards = append(p.Cards, Card{ID: int64(template), Template: template, Level: 1, Stars: 1})
		}
	}
	p.Gems -= int64(count) * r.DrawCost
	receipt.GemsAfter = p.Gems
	p.Draws = append(p.Draws, receipt)
	if p.Dust > ValueLimit {
		return DrawReceipt{}, ErrRule
	}
	return receipt, nil
}

// Manage 共用永久顺序账本；旧序号只能重放相同业务内容，配置热更不重算已经成功的扣款。
func (p *Profile) Manage(c Manage, r Rules, now int64) error {
	if c.Seq == 0 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq <= uint64(len(p.Operations)) {
		if p.Operations[c.Seq-1].Request == c {
			return nil
		}
		return ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq != uint64(len(p.Operations))+1 || len(p.Operations) >= LedgerLimit || r.Validate() != nil {
		return ErrRule
	}
	switch c.Kind {
	case "team":
		if c.CardID != 0 || c.Target != 0 || !p.validTeam(c.Team) {
			return ErrRule
		}
		p.Team = c.Team
	case "level", "star", "gear":
		if c.Team != [3]int64{} {
			return ErrRule
		}
		card := p.card(c.CardID)
		if card == nil {
			return ErrRule
		}
		switch c.Kind {
		case "level":
			if c.Target != card.Level+1 || c.Target > 10 || p.Gold < 5 || p.Dust < 2 {
				return ErrRule
			}
			p.Gold -= 5
			p.Dust -= 2
			card.Level++
		case "star":
			if c.Target != card.Stars+1 || c.Target > 3 || card.Shards < 2 || p.Dust < 3 {
				return ErrRule
			}
			card.Shards -= 2
			p.Dust -= 3
			card.Stars++
		case "gear":
			if c.Target != card.Gear+1 || c.Target > 3 || p.Gold < 3 {
				return ErrRule
			}
			p.Gold -= 3
			card.Gear++
		}
	case "sweep":
		if c.CardID < 1 || c.CardID > 3 || c.Target < 1 || c.Target > 5 || c.Team != [3]int64{} || p.Clears[c.CardID-1] == 0 {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if err := p.Regenerate(now); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		stage := r.Stages[c.CardID-1]
		cost := stage.Energy * c.Target
		if p.Energy < cost || p.Gold > ValueLimit-stage.Gold*c.Target || p.Dust > ValueLimit-c.Target {
			return ErrRule
		}
		p.Energy -= cost
		p.Gold += stage.Gold * c.Target
		p.Dust += c.Target
	case "quest":
		if c.CardID != 1 || c.Target != 0 || c.Team != [3]int64{} || p.Wins < 1 {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if !p.QuestClaimed {
			if p.Gems > ValueLimit-10 {
				return ErrRule
			}
			p.Gems += 10
			p.QuestClaimed = true
		}
	default:
		return ErrRule
	}
	p.Operations = append(p.Operations, Managed{Request: c, ConfigHash: r.Hash()})
	return nil
}

// View 明确裁剪私有密钥与内部重放账本；不要直接同步整个 DAO State 字符串。
type ProfileView struct {
	Gems, Gold, Dust, Energy int64
	Cards                    []Card
	Team                     [3]int64
	ActiveRun                int64
	Clears                   [3]int
	Wins                     int64
}

func (p Profile) View() ProfileView {
	return ProfileView{p.Gems, p.Gold, p.Dust, p.Energy, append([]Card(nil), p.Cards...), p.Team, p.ActiveRun, p.Clears, p.Wins}
}
func ValidTime(now int64) bool { return now > 0 && now < math.MaxInt64-TurnMillis }
